_help: Starter contract for a web service: tests pass AND the service actually answers a health check once it's running. The second verifier is the output of `--verify-http http://localhost:8000/health` (see `loophole run --help`) — build it with that flag instead of hand-editing the command below. Edit 'goal' and the URL/port, then: loophole run --contract loophole.json
goal: TODO: describe the goal in one sentence (what 'done' means)

verifiers.command: i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 5 ]; do code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:8000/health)"; [ "$code" = "200" ] && exit 0; i=$((i+1)); [ "$i" -lt 5 ] && sleep 2; done; exit 1
